Google Open Sources Ambient Quality Agent (AQuA) to Diagnose Production AI Agent Failures
stories.summary: Google has open-sourced AQuA, a reference implementation that analyzes production AI agent sessions, verifies recurring failure patterns, and investigates root causes against deployed source snapshots. In a 32-session replay, developers reduced seat selection bypasses from 15 sessions to two and dietary preference omissions from seven to zero after prompt changes.

The researchers are being redistributed across other teams in what the company frames as a way to accelerate its robotics efforts.

stories.title: SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models
stories.summary: System One models promise fast, general-purpose decision-making without lengthy token generation. However, understanding their capability spectrum and decision reliability requires more than aggregate performance on current benchmarks. Existing evaluations often provide limited insight into the breadth of model capabilities and the reliability of their decisions.

stories.title: OpenAI rebuilt AI shopping from scratch with ChatGPT Wallet
stories.summary: OpenAI is taking a second shot at AI-powered shopping with ChatGPT Wallet after scrapping its first approach, Instant Checkout. Users register a card once and confirm each purchase through Face ID or a fingerprint, while actual card details stay hidden behind payment tokens. Rivals such as Anthropic, Meta, and xAI already have their agents making purchases.

stories.title: Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller
stories.summary: Runway releases its robotics model Praxis-1 with open weights and source code under the Apache 2.0 license. The model uses knowledge from video training for robot control and leads the World Action Model category on Nvidia's RoboLab-120 benchmark. It can't yet plan complex action sequences on its own, though.

stories.title: PhysLoop: Harnessing LLMs' Physics Awareness for Self-Improving Video Generation Models
stories.summary: Video generation models produce visually realistic videos but still struggle with physical dynamics and causal consistency. Learning from generated videos requires fine-grained physical supervision, yet reliable quality judgments, correction pairs, and controlled variations are difficult to obtain.

stories.summary: Forensic report finds Blackwell's fingerprint in DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and Ant Group models

stories.title: BirdDreams: Joint Perspective and BEV Video Generation for a Plausible, Reactive Driving World Model
stories.summary: Driving world models aim to simulate how a scene unfolds under different ego actions. This requires plausible motion of surrounding vehicles as well as precise ego-trajectory control. Learning vehicle motion from perspective video alone is challenging because motion is entangled with appearance and vehicles can be occluded.

stories.title: G-STAR: Group-Scaled Token Capacity for Deeply Compressed Autoregressive Generation
stories.summary: Discrete autoregressive models offer a scalable framework for image generation. However, they face a fundamental trade-off: long token sequences preserve representation quality but slow generation, while aggressive spatial compression reduces representation capacity.

stories.title: Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows
stories.summary: Anthropic's new Claude for Manufacturing plugin connects the AI directly to Autodesk Fusion, Oracle NetSuite, and Infor. Its 17 specialized skills let the AI draft quotes, compare suppliers, and place backup orders when deliveries are delayed, all after human approval. The plugin doesn't control physical machines yet, but Anthropic is separately developing the Model Hardware Standard for that.

stories.title: Duo: A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction
stories.summary: In this report, we introduce the Reciprocal World Model (RWM) and present Duo v1, a full-duplex world model that continuously perceives audiovisual inputs while responding to users in real time. The RWM treats intelligence and physical reality as equally fundamental to what constitutes a world.

stories.title: Former OpenAI researcher says he found Nvidia Blackwell fingerprints hidden inside six Chinese AI models
stories.summary: Former OpenAI researcher Will DePue says he has produced the first technical evidence that DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax, and Ant Group are using Nvidia's latest Blackwell GPUs despite US export controls. His forensic method reads characteristic chip signatures directly from published model weights. He estimates the hardware behind the five training runs cost more than half a billion dollars.

stories.title: HF Transformers 5.23.0
stories.summary: Inkling 2 Small is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs, and it is intended for use in English and other languages and across multiple coding languages. Its language backbone has 48 mixture-of-experts decoder layers, each routing tokens to 8 of 384 experts, for 594B total and 17B active parameters.
